title: Mixed Event — Musical Twilight Parade

meta.Outline: Shiho has been scouted by a band that's ready to make its big debut, giving her a lot to think about. Then, Saki invites her on a visit to Phoenix Wonderland. Meanwhile, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS make their own preparations, eager to host them!

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I've finished cleaning up, so I'll be leaving now.
Thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Yeah, thanks for your help!
Your performance was stellar as usual.
Take it easy now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Nice to see you again, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What do you want this time?
I already told you, I'm not joining your band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
I know, but...
I was just wondering if you changed your mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I haven't...
I'm staying with my current band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Well, that's really a shame...
I was hoping you'd say yes today.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Well, I'll be back again soon so...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hehe... Isn't this where you say something like, Don't bother. I don't care how many times you try...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: This means you really ARE considering my offer, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... I have to go now...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Wait!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
This is a ticket for our next performance.
Come and see us for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I'll sing with everything I have if it means you'll join.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But... Why me...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Didn't I say so before?
It's because I like your sound.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Plus, our band is making its debut under a major label soon. I want to do that with the best team possible.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wouldn't you prefer to stick with the ones you've worked so hard with all this time...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Hehe. So you're the sentimental type?
I really wasn't expecting that...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Playing in a band as a hobby and doing it professionally are completely different things. You won't make it as a pro unless you absolutely commit to it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Those who can't end up bringing down everyone else's morale and just make things difficult for themselves on top of that.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Which is why I don't want bandmates who're only playing for fun and don't have the resolve to really take it seriously.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I was under the impression that you were of the same mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I... Well...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We have a night performance this weekend. If you're still on the fence, come and see us play before making a decision.
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, how did I do just now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Your not hitting those high notes right, Ichika.
The song lacked impact overall,
especially during the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
I'll make sure to practice more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami, you lost focus during the second half,
and I heard mistakes here and there.
Saki also got dragged in and lost sync.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ugh... This is sooo hard...
Especially the rhythm for this part.
I can't wrap my head around it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that also means once you do get it, you'll figure out the best way to move and position your fingers.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's true... Okay, thanks!
Practice makes perfect and all that, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As long as you're not overworking yourself, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'll be careful!
No mistakes next time then!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I'll need to practice more too...
If I really want to become a pro...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, do you have a minute?
I was hoping for some advice about the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry! I know you have your own part to work on...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Quit apologizing and let's practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I do want to get better, but together... With all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Shiho...
Right, thank you.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sigh...
We got so much practice in today too...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We sure did! I'll definitely sleep like a baby tonight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Both of you have improved quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Do you mean that?!
Yaaay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I could tell just by listening too.
You've really been improving.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have to try to keep up...
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This should work, I think...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wow, that was incredible☆
My heart's racing after hearing that♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for roping you into my practice, Rin.
I know you just planned on visiting...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Huh? Why are you apologizing?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I really, really, really LOVE singing with you, Nene☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Then can you stay for one more song?
I want to practice for a little bit more...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Of course♪ Put a smile on that face and make my heart race..!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe, thank you.
I'll start now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I had a lot of fun today, everyone!
See you in school!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The band's growing little by little because everyone's working so hard together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I have to go to work now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, right! Take care.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho continues to play the bass at work even after we're done practicing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I have to keep practicing too...
Especially if I want to reach her level.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But how do I do that exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What a beautiful voice... Who's singing?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She's so good, but it's not just that.
Her voice is so delicate, gentle and free.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wish I could sing like that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Gasp!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I... I'm so sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No! She ran off...
Did I scare her...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But she was so good...
I was hoping to ask how I could sing like her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope I can meet her again...
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm home...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Saki?
You seem more tired than usual...
Wait! Are you feeling unwell?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, I'm totally fine!
I was just tired from band practice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, good. I'm glad you're so enthusiastic about practicing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But even the most brilliant of prodigies need an occasional break to refresh themselves, so that they can reach their fullest potential!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you can have this...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Tickets?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Special complimentary tickets from Phoenix Wonderland. I just happened to receive four of them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't you drop by with everyone this weekend? Come watch our show and go home with the biggest smiles on your faces!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow... Thanks a bunch!
I'm sure the girls would love this!
We haven't been to PXL in ages!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll be there to watch your show for sure!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Listen up, everyone!
We're going to PXL together this weekend!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa gave me enough tickets for all of us!
We used to go when we were little, remember?
I thought it'd be a nice break from practicing too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...!
Yes, I would love to go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've all been so tired from practice lately. Maybe this is just the thing we need to make our performances even better!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's true...
I'm for it too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What about you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'll pass. I want to practice.
You three go on ahead without me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wh-What is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did you know that if you go now, they'll be selling limited edition Phenny Penguin merch?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we might even be able to shake hands with Poochie since Tsukasa works there! How can you say no to that?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll practice like crazy after!
Like, really, really hard! I mean it!
So much that even you'll be surprised!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So please... Can we go together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (What do I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I already turned her down once because I had something to do...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, fine.
I've been after that special Phenny Penguin so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! This is gonna be awesome!
Weekend
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That was awesome, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Your singing sounds more tra-la-la-la now☆
And it even feels sparkly too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I think I know a great way to make you sparkle even more☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Check. This. Out...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ta-da☆ You just need a big smile!
Your voice will feel happier♪
And you'll sparkle even more☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It'll give everyone watching a big smiley face too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really... Okay.
I'll try to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah☆ We can do it together too...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nene!
Tsukasa's asking everyone to gather for a rehearsal♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah, okay...! I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
"Come on, everyone!!
Let us sing and dance!!
All for this glorious day!!!!"
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So loud...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa sounds super psyched today!
Did something good happen to him?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apparently, his sister and some of her friends will be visiting Phoenix Wonderland today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So he's all fired up and even said,
"I'm going to put on the greatest show ever!"

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Tsukasa sometimes takes time off to look after his sister when she's sick and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He must really love her a lot!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, I guess everyone has one good quality about them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hahahaha!
I'm on the roll of all rolls today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When Saki and her friends watch us perform, all their anxieties will melt away and refresh their spirits for band practice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wonderhoy☆
We're right behind you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't particularly care...
It's not like I don't ever try my hardest...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True. So let's give it our all and bring smile to everyone's faces today like we always do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe! You're all really raring to go☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna be in lots and lots more shows with everyone too♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Rin! You're at the stage today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, Rin hasn't been coming to the stage very often, huh? Where were you all this time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I've been all over the place, performing shows and giving everyone big smiley faces☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa, that sounds like fun!
I want to perform in different places too,
and make people smile everywhere I go...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then let's go together next time☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Together, we can make much, much, MUCH happier shows than ever before♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you've got yourself a deal!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmph! We can't lose the spotlight to them!
Let's do one more rehearsal just to be sure!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just don't overdo it before the actual show.
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...! It's really PXL!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's been so long since we last came here together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow... I was expecting a lot to have changed, but it's almost all the same.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Doesn't this bring back memories?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, is Tsukasa waiting for us somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! He said he wants to introduce us to the rest of his troupe today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's nice. I'm looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! I wonder what they're like♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, there he is!
Tsukasaaa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hello, Saki, and everyone from Leo/need!
Welcome to my Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, Phoenix Wonderland isn't yours...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem! Anyway...!
Allow me to introduce you to my troupe,
the amazing cast of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And everyone, this is our special guest...!
The one I invited here today. My sister...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!! It's Saki!
Wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu! I didn't know you were performing in the same shows as my brother!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I knew she performed in PXL shows, but I had no idea she was in the same troupe as Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait... Isn't she in your class, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What's that...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a small world after all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After getting so worked up about his grand introduction too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh! That girl... She was the one singing at the park the other day... She's also in Tsukasa's troupe...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe I can ask her for some tips about becoming a better singer...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Urgh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you hiding behind me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No reason...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sorry about this.
Nene's a little shy around strangers.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry, she'll be able to converse normally once she gets to know you better. Please give her some time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, since we're all here,
let's all visit some attractions together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, it's not every day I get to meet my classmates at Phoenix Wonderland like this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Our show starts in the evening anyway.
We have time, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's get to know each other by having lots of fun together! That's what being wonderhoy is all about☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
We already finished rehearsing this morning.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true. Then...
Why don't we show all of you around the park?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes, please! I'd love to get to know everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime better too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too!
What about you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you say, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine by me. I'm here for you today anyway, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yaaay! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Follow us, then! Your epic adventure around Phoenix Wonderland is about to begin☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Aww, Nene!
What's with the long face?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<This is a great chance to make new friends, isn't it?
Bring your smiley face and have some fun☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What...?! Rin?!
You'll startle people if they see you like this.
You need to be a little more discreet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But, but, but...
I was just so worried about you, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I appreciate that. I really do... But I just can't help but feel nervous around people I've never met before...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hmmm... Nervous, you say...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I know☆ I can be the small voice in your ear that eggs you on to smile and have fun with everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You don't have to. Imagine what would happen if someone saw you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Don't worry! I'll be super stealthy!
Sneaky sneak☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's not really sneaky at all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But thank you... I won't be able to open up to them right away, but I'll try to make it happen.
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next is the super fun, exciting and psychedelic area known as Dreamland☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...! I used to LOVE this place as a kid!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Where you're supposed to be in a dream world or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. Home of the Fluffy☆Trampoline Dome that lets you feel like you're bouncing high above the clouds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And Phenny's Dreamy Night, a cart ride that takes you through Phenny Penguin's fantastical dreams!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember you really loved the Trampoline Dome, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! The feeling of jumping around all those fluffy clouds was the best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. It's been one of your favorites since you were little. We'd always go to the Trampoline Dome, but you kept begging us to go back in for seconds or even thirds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'd convince you to give up, but then you wouldn't stop sulking after that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The only way to cheer you up was to buy you a fruit parfait from the park restaurant. It happened so much, it's still fresh in my head.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't bring up old stories like that, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I can totally see that happening.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! That's really nice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: After all, Phoenix Wonderland is a place that puts a smile on everyone's face☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like Tsukasa and Saki, people have been coming here since they were little, and again as high school students or grown-ups. They get to enjoy the park in different ways every time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I want this place to be where everyone can smile and have fun no matter how old they are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! I completely agree!
PXL will always have a special place in my heart!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A special place where my childhood memories and the fun times I had with Tsukasa and everyone from Leo/need are♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone has a lot of fond memories of this place...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I used to perform here occasionally, but I don't think I ever came here with someone else just to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that sense, I guess you could say the fondest memories I have of this place are the shows we've been performing as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's the same for me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then... Why don't we make some nice memories together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Since we're already here, we can see different attractions and have fun together, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, together... Including you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright☆
In order to make many good memories together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I propose that we visit as many attractions in Dreamland as possible!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Count me in!
Where should we start?
No, it has to be the Trampoline Dome!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Jumping on a trampoline at our age might be kind of embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, no way...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We might end up scaring the children playing inside if so many of us went in at once. Let's try something else this time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Nene! Hey, Nene! Now's the time for you to try to start a conversation with everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That's easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
K-Kusanagi!
Do you have any suggestions?
Any ride or attractions you're interested in?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh?! Um, I...
I think...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (You can do it, Nene!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How about that one?
Phenny's Nightmare!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's a haunted house, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's a little dark and creepy just like it's name suggests!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-Is it that scary...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, not at all!
The attraction is designed to be family-friendly.
It has comical props to amuse people of all ages!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then that should be fine, I think...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How can a haunted house be any fun if it isn't scary?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I-It's still super fun! This is a haunted house that puts a big smile on everyone's faces☆

rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
Let's go join them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sigh... That was a lot scarier than I imagined...

rows.Line: Yeah... I was just surprised because I haven't gone to that many haunted houses before...

rows.Line:

I couldn't tell it was just konjac jelly at first!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That was actually pretty funny.

rows.Line: Yes. Some effects were old-fashioned, but their simplicity added to the element of surprise. I've learned much from this experience.

rows.Line: Great! I can definitely handle something like that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're volunteering?!
Then I'll prepare some piping hot konjac for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why piping hot?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahaha♪ Tsukasa looks like he's having fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He would be with such interesting friends.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Has that roller coaster always been there?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I don't think so.
It must be new.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It feels different from everything else, doesn't it? That whole area seems to follow more of a futuristic theme.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
There are more thrill rides than before too.
And they all look pretty scary...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean they made a new area?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, I'm sure Emu would know!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu, do you know anything about that roller coaster...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, um...! If you're looking for a fun roller coaster, I recommend the Go! Go! Phenny! coaster over there☆ Come on, let's gooo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay? Uh, let's go...!
Roller Coaster
se_event_parade_2021_002

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Build suspense by pausing just before the drop...
And then...
se_event_parade_2021_003

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the coaster speeds up during the drop, riders are treated to a view of Phoenix Wonderland in its full glory...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The exhilaration one feels after being liberated from that initial tension... What a wonderful setup, indeed.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Ichika
rows.Line: AAAHHHHHHHH!!!
se_event_parade_2021_003
Coffee Cup

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Round and round and round and round!
Gaaaaaah!!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Waaaargh! This is amazing, Tsukasa!
The whole world's spinning like crazy♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Ts-Tsukasa!
This is a bit too much, don't you think?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No! We can do even better!! Let it be known that I settle for nothing but the best performance in everything I do!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, they seem to be having a fun time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa definitely is.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We don't have to compete with them, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahaha♪
Ferris Wheel

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're almost at the top, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow...
PXL looks so different from up here!
Isn't this amazing?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can take our time with the view here, unlike the roller coaster.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I could stay on that ride forever♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, I think I'm okay for now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Phew... That was certainly a lot of fun.
Shall we find a place to rest for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Why don't we get some Phenny Penguin manju?
There's a set that comes with drinks too☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sounds like a plan. Wait here for me.
I'll go get some for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you so much...!
You're so thoughtful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Tsukasa!
See you later!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's already this late...

rows.Line: We haven't had so much fun at PXL together since we were in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right! It feels kinda weird because we'd usually still be practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're right.
But I feel like playing the guitar now, actually.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! I've been tapping to a rhythm for a while already...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You too, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm still a terrible drummer who always relies on Shiho, but I just want everyone to know that I really love our band!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's nice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
By the way...
When did you start playing the bass, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I vaguely remember it was from elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, I've been curious about that too!
All of a sudden, you just started playing one day!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did it seem like that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to know too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's nothing that dramatic really...

rows.Line: You know my father's a musician, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! He's a guitarist, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right, and he took me along to see all sorts of shows when I was still little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:

Their show was just so cool and amazing...

rows.Line: Really? I didn't know that! What did they sound like?

rows.Line: You should be able to find them with a quick search. They turned pro just a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can also lend you their CD if you're really interested.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?! Thanks, Shiho!
I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you mind if I borrow it afterwards?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. They've gotten better since turning pro too, so we could definitely use their performances as a reference.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They must be really good for you praise them like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. I respect them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Their music has a way of really getting my heart going...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It makes me want to shout out or cry...
I just can't sit still after listening to them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I want to touch someone's heart with my music, like they did with mine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's why I have to get better...
I want to become a pro and reach more people.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So that my music can really get them going too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now I understand...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A professional, huh?
I've never thought about that before.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'd probably have to practice even harder than we are right now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yikes... That sounds rough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should've known... None of them are thinking about aiming higher, are they?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't even begin to imagine what the world of professional musicians is like...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it has to be fun if it allows more people to listen to our music, like Shiho says.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'd have to get much better first...)

rows.Line: Is it just me or did their conversation become somber all of the sudden?

rows.Line: It's not just you. I can't hear them clearly, but it sounds quite serious.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're in a band together, yes? I'm sure they have quite a lot to talk about since they're dedicated to the same craft and all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gasp...! Guys, it's almost time for the show to start!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Already?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, she's right.
Shall we start getting ready then?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki! We're heading to Wonder Stage to get ready for the show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come and watch us later!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, got it!
Break a leg, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know you'll love our show!
I guarantee it'll make you grin from ear to ear☆

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So we go straight down this way...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, is that it? There's a sign that says,
Wonder Stage this way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And it's handwritten...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nice... In a very homey way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh!
The show's about to start too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We should hurry!

rows.Line: Let's make today's show absolutely perfect as always!!

rows.Line: What's the matter, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, well... I was just a little concerned about Hoshino and her friends. They were talking so seriously before we left.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All the more reason we should make this show our best one yet!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our show can make them smile brightly and lighten the mood for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... You may be right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I just hope my singing can do that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your terrific singing voice will be just the thing they need to hear, Nene!

rows.Line: Wow! We're finally here!

rows.Line:
But it took us ten minutes to get over here...
This place is way too inaccessible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And yet, there's so many people here!
This is incredible!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is it just standing room only now?

rows.Line:
Hey, there's enough space over there!
Hurry, let's go...!

rows.Line:
Whoa, Saki! Stop pulling!

rows.Line: Oh, it's starting...!

rows.Line: A song that bring peace? Is such a thing possible?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Her song will help everyone in this land, who has lost their smile, to remember what it means to feel joy!

rows.Line: Do you also want to listen to her sing, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Kids
rows.Line: Yeeeah!
se_event_parade_2021_001

rows.Line: They seem like different people altogether compared to a little while ago.

rows.Line:
I know, right!

rows.Line: Oh! Look at that...!

rows.Line: I can sing too.

rows.Line:
Whoa, that robot's amazing too!

rows.Line: And it can even tap dance...!

rows.Line: How can it do all of this?

rows.Line: I must admit... That robot has got quite the singing voice, but it still can't hold a candle to our songstress!

rows.Line:
Come forth, songstress!

rows.Line: Is she gonna be okay after getting this much hype?

rows.Line: Please, listen to my song...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (I really wish I could sing like that too...)

rows.Line: She's amazing...

rows.Line: (Everyone's better than I expected, but Nene's singing voice is especially beautiful...)

rows.Line: (With this sort of talent, larger theatrical troupes should be falling over themselves trying to recruit her.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Line: And everyone lived happily ever after...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You were all awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hehehe... You've got that right.
All of our shows are done to perfection!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
All that practice really paid off☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And you were absolutely incredible, Kusanagi.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (But I'm glad I did...)

rows.Line: (Because everyone's smiling so brightly now...)

rows.Line: But don't stay too late, understand?

rows.Line:

Thanks for today!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
<It's so sad to just say goodbye like this!

rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kusanagi, there's something I want to ask you.

rows.Line: Do you have time?

rows.Line: Kusanagi, there's something I want to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Don't worry. Leave the cleaning up to us.
I'll start from that side.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fine, so be it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Time to make this place squeaky clean☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We'll wait for you over there...
You want to talk alone, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Come find us when you're done, okay!
Let's go, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What is it you want to ask...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your show was incredible.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't usually watch shows like this and had no idea what I was supposed to take away from it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But because you sang so well, I couldn't help but be drawn into the world that was being presented...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why I'm confused.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: With your talent, you could definitely be in a much larger theatre troupe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Out of the stages here in Phoenix Wonderland, this is one of the smaller ones.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'll definitely be able to shine brighter on a larger stage and get more people to listen to your songs like that, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What makes you want to do shows here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That's none of your...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's waiting for my answer with such a serious look on her face...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I don't know why she's asking this,
but if my answer can help her somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The reason I'm here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you... All of you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I remembered how to sing the way I used to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel like I got my own Christmas present a little early...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Funny, but I feel that way too. Don't you, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. I get what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your smile, Nene! I've never seen you smile like this before!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure exactly either...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But, well...
I'm just like performing here, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's all?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We're gonna play together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Which song?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wrote lyrics for a song Saki composed earlier.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys have already written a song? Nice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's amazing! Can I see the lyrics?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, maybe later? It's kind of embarrassing to have them read in front of me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I hope we can all perform it... Together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think I sort of understand...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to go pro and get better.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want to play music that can really move people, like that band can.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I like performing with them too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That show was really interesting, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And Tsukasa was so cool too♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I wonder what Shiho could be talking to Kusanagi about...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's the matter, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry! I think I left something behind.
I'm gonna go look for it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I'll definitely regret it if I go home like this.
I have to talk to Kusanagi now!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're already done talking to her?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. What are you doing here, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I left something behind.
Sorry, I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sigh... Talk about a surprise.
I wasn't expecting a question like that at all...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Teehee☆ You should've seen how happy you looked when you were answering her, Nene♪ You were thinking about Emu and the others, right?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you talking about...?
Okay, well... I may've felt like that a little...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure if my answer was good or bad, but I really hope it helps her with whatever's on her mind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh... H-Hoshino?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Wh-What is it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's that I...
I'm the vocalist for our band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it's not going as well as I'd hoped...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I really want to get better for Shiho...
No, for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
When I heard you sing, I was really touched!
I want to be able to sing like you too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: L-Like me...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So if you don't mind... Can you please teach me how to sing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know you're probably busy with school and practice so... Whenever you're free! It doesn't have to be regular!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My singing is actually touching the hearts of the people listening to me. People like Hinomori and Hoshino...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm really happy but teaching someone...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Come on, Nene! You got this!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay. If you're sure you want me to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Gasp...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also you don't have to be so formal with me. I'm guessing we're around the same age so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry to keep you waiting...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi! You sure took your time...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did you find what you were looking for?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I have what I need.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's great!
Let's go grab us some souvenirs now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Line:
Teaching her how to sing...
Am I even capable of that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You'll be fine♪
And I'll be there to help you too☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene looks really happy☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Her singing was a lot more polished than usual today. She must have been practicing hard by herself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I didn't like how she completely overshadowed me, but I'll allow it since she did make Saki and her friends really happy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why are you all staring at me like that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's nothing! It's not like anyone saw you smirking by yourself over there at all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
How'd you know that if you didn't see?
And I'm not alone. Rin's here too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hello, everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, it's really Rin!
Did you get to see our show too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I did☆ And everyone was brilliant♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph... It goes without saying that I was the most brilliant of us all, yes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whatever you say.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Man, that was so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. The show was really nice too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting us here, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee! No need to thank me! After all, I was just looking for an excuse to hang out with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In exchange for practicing harder starting tomorrow, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yup... I'll practice until I can play that part I was struggling with the other day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But before that... Here you go♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? What's this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A limited edition Phenny Penguin keychain!
I bought one for each of us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, when did you do that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ Secretly, before we left!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Remember what Emu said?
PXL is a place where people come to have fun
and make fond memories together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanted us all to have something to remember this day by!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you!
Now we have matching keychains!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Aren't they awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here's yours, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll put it in my bag for now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, Shiho! You dropped something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Is that a ticket?
Are you going to see a show?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Gasp...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Playing in a band as a hobby and doing it professionally are completely different things. You won't make it as a pro unless you absolutely commit to it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Which is why I don't want bandmates who're only playing for fun and don't have the resolve to really take it seriously.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: We have a night performance this weekend. If you're still on the fence, come and see us play before making a decision.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's nothing. I got it from someone at work.
Don't worry about it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... I hope we can hold our own show one day...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! But we'll need a lot more practice before we can even think about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Urgh... I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's visit PXL another day too!
I wanna watch Tsukasa perform again!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We should!
I really want to hear Kusanagi sing again too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And Emu did say she would continue showing us around next time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I like playing with everyone as Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But they're not thinking about becoming professionals...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So I probably shouldn't force them to spend time practicing with me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm sure they'd rather have fun by hanging out together instead of practicing like this.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Which is why I...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shiho, are you okay?
You seem a little down...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm fine, don't worry about me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, really. I have to go now so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See you tomorrow, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yup. Bye then...
Live House

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hinomori?
I thought you were off today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm here as a spectator today.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Oh, you're here to see STANDOUT. They've really been getting a lot of attention lately. Well, I hope you enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you, I will...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm just here to watch them perform.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's all...
